editorial:
Imagine you are Gordon, a nice English teacher in Brooklyn who finally finds the love of his life. He is totally head over heels for a French girl, and for a while, everything feels like a dream. The vibe is light, sweet, and full of that new-relationship energy. But things get messy fast when she gets a job offer as a head chef back in Quebec City. You will feel for Gordon because the guy she is working for isn't just some random boss; he is her ex-boyfriend and a famous TV chef with looks that could kill. It turns into a funny and stressful battle of the hearts.

The acting is great because you really feel the tension between the awkward teacher and the polished celebrity chef. The pacing is quick, though some of the arguments feel a bit repetitive. If you love romantic comedies with a bit of a rivalry, you will enjoy this one. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the beautiful shots of Quebec City, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. It is a perfect choice for a date night or just a lazy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: In the end, the French girl realizes that the celebrity chef only cares about his image and his show, not her. She chooses the honest and loving Gordon over the fame and the fancy kitchen. She turns down the job offer and decides to stay in Brooklyn. Gordon is thrilled, and they commit to their future together. It wraps up with a sweet scene showing that true love beats a fancy resume any day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sweet rom-coms and love triangles.
